translations.web: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.
translations.bsb: For anyone who eats and drinks without recognizing the body eats and drinks judgment on himself.
translations.kjv: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord's body.
translations.asv: For he that eateth and drinketh, eateth and drinketh judgment unto himself, if he discern not the body.
